source_results.v074_key_result: CLASS-native transfer tangent affinity passed strongly (~2.9e-4 max) while transfer power failed to close pk_lin, with disagreement concentrated at the structured higher-k part of the fixed grid.

question: Does increasing the CLASS scalar/Fourier k sampling density make pk_lin converge to the CLASS-native transfer reconstruction and recover lambda-affine tangent response on the unchanged v0.63 fixed grid?

frozen_physical_model.eta0_variational_forcing: same positive-Drude source-grid construction with control order 512 and primary order 1024; rebuilt separately at each preregistered k-resolution so the strict force table has support on that resolution's CLASS k grid

resolution_policy.reason_for_pairs: CLASS uses separate outside-BAO and BAO k densities. Each level multiplies both default densities by the same factor 1,2,4,8 so the audit is a genuine global k-resolution sequence rather than changing only one sampling region.

primary_observables.transfer_path: Class.get_transfer(z, output_format='class') using d_m at the exact requested k modes
primary_observables.transfer_power_identity: P_transfer=(2*pi^2/k^3)*d_m^2*P_R(k), with k in 1/Mpc and P_R=A_s*(k/k_pivot)^(n_s-1)
primary_observables.lambda_affinity_metric: global normalized RMS deviation of each lambda response from the four-lambda consensus

classification_policy.meaning_of_pass: At the preregistered highest k resolution, pk_lin closes the CLASS-native transfer power and its eta=0 tangent is lambda-affine, while r4 is also converged against r3. This is a numerical CLASS-resolution certification only; it is not observational evidence and does not simulate nonlinear evolution.
classification_policy.meaning_of_fail: Keep the failure and report which preregistered gate failed. Do not extend the resolution sequence, change the physical model, grid, tangent amplitudes, or thresholds as a rescue of v0.75. Any later follow-up must be separately preregistered.
